name: What should I look for when comparing different roof replacement estimates?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when comparing different roof replacement estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing roof replacement estimates, look beyond just the bottom-line price. Verify that each estimate includes similar scope of work, materials, and warranty information. Pay attention to line items such as tear-off and disposal, underlayment, ventilation, and any hidden fees. A comprehensive estimate will clearly itemize all costs, allowing you to understand what you are paying for and make an informed comparison.
acceptedAnswer.description: When comparing estimates, check for similar scope of work, materials, warranties, and detailed itemization of all costs and services.
